Hi,

Thank you for your application to Next Stage Talent.

We're pleased to let you know that you've been shortlisted for an interview with one of our agents. We represent talent across acting, modelling, commercials and extra work, and we're genuinely excited to find out more about you.

The interview is an opportunity for us to assess your personality, confidence and experience — and equally a chance for you to ask us anything about how we work and what representation looks like in practice.

A few things worth knowing before you book:

We operate as a sole trader business, not a limited company.
We are a commission-based agency, charging 20% commission on paid work. We only earn when you do.
There are no upfront agency, registration or joining fees.
Our agents are registered on Spotlight, one of the industry's leading casting platforms.
A professional portfolio is only required if we proceed with your representation.

We follow a selection process, starting with Zoom and followed by an office meeting if successful. Our office address isn't published publicly due to previous open casting calls attracting large numbers of visitors. We'll provide the full address when inviting you.

If you are happy with the above, please use the button below to book your appointment at a time that suits you.

We look forward to meeting you!

Next Stage Talent

Representing talent across film, TV, commercials and modelling.
